## 问题与改动 / Problem and change

说明触发场景，以及修改前后的行为。 / Describe the trigger and before/after behavior.

## 验证 / Validation

列出实际执行的命令与结果；未执行的验证明确标注。涉及数据库时注明类型和版本。
List commands actually run and their results; identify skipped checks. Include database types and versions when relevant.

## 风险与迁移 / Risks and migration

说明配置、数据迁移或部署影响；不适用时填写“不适用 / N/A”。
Describe configuration, migration or deployment effects, or state N/A.

## 第三方内容 / Third-party material

新增或移植代码、依赖和素材时，附来源、准确版本及许可声明位置；无此类改动填写 N/A。
For imported code, dependencies or assets, provide origin, exact version and notice location; otherwise state N/A.

- [ ] 已阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md，且未提交凭据或敏感数据。 / Read CONTRIBUTING.md; no credentials or sensitive data included.
- [ ] 已按改动范围保留许可和署名，并同步相关文档。 / Preserved applicable notices and updated relevant documentation.
